results.title: Tourists
results.overview: In a Romanian forest known for its supernatural phenomena, a tour guide faces tourists demanding a refund after claiming they saw a ghost.

results.title: Dead Land
results.overview: A group of close-knit 20-somethings drag their grieving friend to a mysterious haunted house attraction, and as the night unfolds, she is forced to face the nightmares of her past.

results.title: A Useful Ghost
results.original_title: ผีใช้ได้ค่ะ
results.overview: Worried about her husband being allergic to dust, Nat, a recently-dead woman, returns as a ghost possessing a vacuum cleaner to clean the house.

results.title: Youth Eternal
results.overview: A coming of age story about a group of millennials who start to face their self-destructive tendencies as they each head straight into their crisis of thirtysomethings.

results.title: Oratorio
results.overview: Because of Mirel's unrequited love for Yura, she has not been able to fall in love with someone else for 11 years. Desperate to meet her love, she decides to become a nun. Mirel sings in the choir of the Catholic church, where Yura comes to arrange his wedding.

results.title: Hittin Licks
results.overview: A grieving young woman embarks on a path of vengeance against a local crime boss, whom she holds responsible for the tragic death of her mother.

results.title: The Residence
results.overview: In the near future, during a health crisis, novelist Clarissa Katsef visits the Ludovico Foundation housing complex in search of inspiration. With the help of her AI assistant Dalloway, she finds fresh inspiration as she immerses herself in her writing.

results.title: The Land of the Whale
results.overview: For filmmaker Armando Capó, the southeastern Cuban town of Gibara is a place of ghosts, haunted by his lost youth, a bustling past that cannot be recovered — and the skeleton of a whale. THE LAND OF THE WHALE is a beautiful meditation on craft, beauty, aging, the transmission of knowledge, and what it means to be an artist.

results.title: The Fostered
results.overview: Thirteen-year-old twin girls are fostered into a home with a dysfunctional couple and find people are not always who they seem.

results.title: Casefield
results.overview: Carter Williams, an apathetic journalism student, investigates a years-old missing person's in a rural town and uncovers a Catholic Church harboring secrets.

results.title: Neighborhood Watch
results.overview: When a mentally ill young man thinks he witnesses an abduction and the police refuse to believe him, he reluctantly turns to his next door neighbor – a bitter, retired security guard – to help him find the missing woman.

results.title: Ultimate Weapon
results.overview: In search of a lost psychotronic weapon, director Dragoș Turea explores the secrets of psychotronic warfare and the USSR's involvement in the development of technologies that used the power of the mind for military purposes. On his journey through Moldova and Ukraine, he discovers a hidden world where scientists and parapsychologists from the former Soviet space were trained in covert experiments that defy the boundaries of reality. The film raises a controversial question: Can the power of thought be transformed into a weapon?

results.title: Door
results.overview: Vafa, who works as a maid in the house of an influential businessman, decides to commit a robbery to start a new life. To do this, she turns to her brother Vidadi, who has not been able to see his son for more than a year due to unpaid child support and has grown tired of such a life. After convincing her brother, they also suggest involving their step-cousin Javad, who has been imprisoned several times for theft. During the robbery, Javad and Vidadi break the door and get stuck in the house. After that, events unfold even more dramatically.

results.title: Out of Love
results.overview: When Jeanne, a meticulous insurance assessor, is suddenly left to care for her estranged sister’s two children after their mother vanishes, her carefully ordered life begins to unravel. Confronted with unexpected responsibilities, she must balance the fragile task of earning the children’s trust while also tending to her own relationship with her girlfriend, who struggles to adjust to Jeanne’s new role. As grief, uncertainty, and shifting loyalties mount, Jeanne finds herself redefining what family and love truly mean.

results.title: Leo & Lou
results.overview: Leo, an orphaned mute girl who can't fit in, escapes from the shelter where she lives in order to go to a fishing competition that reminds her of her parents. On the way, Lou, a non-conformist with no job or benefit, finds her hitchhiking and, without knowing Leo's real purpose, agrees to take her in his car, thinking he is taking her back home. Together they will embark on an adventure in which, despite the obstacles they encounter along the way, they will become inseparable and discover the extraordinary meaning of the word family.

results.title: Urchin
results.overview: Mike, a rough sleeper in London, is trapped in a cycle of self-destruction as he attempts to turn his life around. Along the way, he encounters unexpected chances for a fresh start.

results.title: Four Letters of Love
results.overview: Nicholas and Isabel were made for each other but how will they ever know it? As ghosts, fate and the sheer power of true love pull them together, so too does life threaten to tear them apart.

results.title: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
results.original_title: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
results.overview: Shelley Beattie, a Deaf woman and champion bodybuilder, found fame in the 1990s on the hit TV show American Gladiators, where she competed under the name "Siren" before her untimely death in 2008. While charismatic, gorgeous, and a fierce competitor, Beattie also battled personal demons, struggling with mental illness, addiction, and questions of her own identity. Framed by the insight of another Deaf woman in Hollywood who found herself in the spotlight at the same time, Academy Award-winning actress Marlee Matlin, the documentary unpacks the story of Shelley "Siren" Beattie and her complex legacy entwined with beauty, mental illness, and love.
